a) Hyperparameters.: As per the hyperparameters, for F EDAVG and CNN we search the server step-size η ∈ {2, 1.5, 1, 0.5, 0.1}
and local step-size ηl ∈ {0.1, 0.05, 0.01, 0.005} and found the best performing to be η = 1.5 and ηl = 0.01. For R ES N ET-20,
we search the server step-size η ∈ {1.5, 1, 0.1} and local step-size ηl ∈ {1, 0.5, 0.1, 0.01} and found the best performing to
be η = 1 and ηl = 0.5. Similarly, for F ED CM and CNN we search the server step-size η ∈ {1, 0.5, 0.1, 0.05} and local
step-size ηl ∈ {1, 0.5, 0.1, 0.05} and found the best performing to be η = 0.1 and ηl = 0.1. For R ES N ET-20, we search the
server step-size η ∈ {1.5, 1, 0.5, 0.1} and local step-size ηl ∈ {1, 0.5, 0.1, 0.5} and found the best performing to be η = 1 and
ηl = 0.1. The momentum factor is searched among β ∈ {0.95, 0.9, 0.85} and set as β = 0.9.
